title: Unpaid invoices, with follow-ups written
summary: Who owes you what, and a polite message for each customer that you send yourself.
text: List every invoice still unpaid on [asof], with the customer, the amount and how many days late it is, and write the total in owed.md. Then, for each customer who owes us, write a short, polite message in the company's voice in its own file in the follow-ups folder. Promise nothing our terms file does not give. Do not send anything; I will send the messages myself.
